name: Davis
description: A simple, fully translatable admin interface for sabre/dav based on Symfony 5 and Bootstrap 5, initially inspired by Baïkal. Provides user edition, calendar creation and sharing, and address book creation. The interface is simple and straightforward, responsive, and provides a light and a dark mode.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Admin password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-davis application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-davis
  # The `big-bear-davis` service definition
  big-bear-davis:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-davis
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: ghcr.io/tchapi/davis-standalone:5.4.1@sha256:9db11b957fdce6d56c04185793c149b62db1596035feb876878acef6b3421be4
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables to be set in the container
    environment:
      - APP_ENV=prod
      - DATABASE_DRIVER=mysql
      - DATABASE_URL=mysql://bigbear:${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}@big-bear-davis-mysql:3306/davis?serverVersion=10.6.10&charset=utf8mb4
      - MAILER_DSN=smtp://:@big-bear-davis-mailpit:1025
      - ADMIN_LOGIN=bigbear
      - ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - AUTH_REALM=
      - AUTH_METHOD=
      - CALDAV_ENABLED=
      - CARDDAV_ENABLED=
      - WEBDAV_ENABLED=
      - WEBDAV_TMP_DIR=
      - WEBDAV_PUBLIC_DIR=
      - WEBDAV_HOMES_DIR=
      - INVITE_FROM_ADDRESS=
      - APP_TIMEZONE=UTC
    # Ports to be exposed from the container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:9000"
    networks:
      - big-bear-davis-network
    depends_on:
      - big-bear-davis-mysql
      - big-bear-davis-mailpit
  # Service name: big-bear-davis-mailpit
  big-bear-davis-mailpit:
    container_name: big-bear-davis-mailpit # Container name for the app service
    image: axllent/mailpit:v1.32@sha256:0790692be935ea4420d085694f7985b1f692ca6a8771ab0e0bd8ba75ac180498 # Image for the app service
    restart: unless-stopped # Restart policy for the container
    volumes: # Volumes to mount for the app service
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mailpit/data:/data
    environment: # Environment variables for the app service
      - TZ=UTC
    ports: # Ports to expose for the app service
      - "8025:8025"
      - "1025:1025"
    networks:
      - big-bear-davis-network
  # Service name: big-bear-mysql
  big-bear-davis-mysql:
    container_name: big-bear-davis-mysql
    image: mariadb:10.6.10@sha256:d1bd65504ffbea8dc7445223c9a9b1e6dc7d93f49f5ceff352bb9d43f52d0ffa
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=davis
      - MYSQL_USER=bigbear
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - big-bear-davis-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      timeout: 5s
networks:
  big-bear-davis-network:
    driver: bridge
